title: Flight Planner
impact: Shipped a PWA that reduced itinerary recompute latency by 30% via caching and parallelism.
context: Weekend project growing into a polished PWA for quick multi-city planning.
results: Cut recompute latency with memoized route graph and cache invalidation.
Added CI tests to block regressions and flakiness.
Introduced offline mode to keep itineraries available.
learnings: Cache policies must model user intent, not objects.
Synthetic tests catch painful edge cases early.

title: Air Quality Nowcasting
impact: Deployed a nowcasting model that improved RMSE by 12% and refreshed every 15 minutes.
context: Research-to-prod pipeline for air quality nowcasts using sensor and satellite data.
results: Quantized model to ONNX, reducing inference cost by 25%.
Built evaluation dashboard and automated backtests.
Containerized inference and deployed behind CDN.
learnings: Small data quality wins beat complex models.
Backtests are the contract with the future.

title: Email Triage Agent
impact: Designed an agent that drafts responses and auto-labels, saving ~3h/week.
context: Inbox assistant with prompt design, few-shot tuning, and safety checks.
results: Implemented guardrails to refuse PII exfiltration and risky actions.
Optimized prompts cutting token usage ~30% with no quality loss.
Added feedback loop to learn from user corrections.
learnings: Guardrails are UX features, not just safety.

title: SkyWash on CIRRUS
impact: Case study of a containerized deployment on a low-cost edge cluster.
context: Documented rollout with health checks, blue/green deploys, and observability.
results: Added canary and blue/green to reduce risk during releases.
Configured dashboards and alerts on SLOs.
